newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE says Albania mission may be delayed.
newsitem.headline: OSCE says Albania mission may be delayed.

text.p: The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) said on Wednesday its fact-finding mission to Albania may be delayed beyond this week's planned departure.
"Originally the mission was to leave tomorrow but it now seems the timing has been put in question," an OSCE spokeswoman told Reuters in Vienna. She declined to give details.

The OSCE said on Tuesday it had asked former Austrian chancellor Franz Vranitzky to travel to Albania as soon as possible to assess the situation in the troubled Balkan nation, where a state of emergency has been declared.
Western diplomatic sources told Reuters the delay had been caused by the Albanian government, which had told the OSCE that the timing of the mission may not be opportune.
"The Albanians said they don't know whether this is the right time," the source said.

The source said the OSCE was still in talks with the Albanian government and hoped to reach an agreement which would allow the mission to leave on Thursday, as planned. "They've agreed to it, so they just can't say 'no' now," the source added.
